info.name: NextKeeWeb
info.summary: Open and edit KeePass (KDBX) password databases stored in your Nextcloud
info.description:
Open and edit KeePass databases (.kdbx) directly in Nextcloud, compatible with KeePassXC, KeePass and KeePassDX.
- Databases are decrypted only in your browser; the server never sees your master password or the contents. - Open `.kdbx` files from the Files app with a click, or from the app with the file picker and a list of recently opened databases. - Changes made elsewhere (KeePassXC through the desktop client, another browser) are merged instead of overwritten. - KDBX 3.1 and 4.x, Argon2d/Argon2id, AES-KDF, AES and ChaCha20, key files. - Groups, search with KeePassXC syntax, entry history, attachments, TOTP, password generator.
info.author: Jan-Hendrik Meyer
